theme_context.description: Premium Dark Visual Language for a high-end music distribution platform (RILIS MUSIK). Matches the aesthetic of professional audio software (DAWs) and top-tier SaaS dashboards. High density, high contrast, and serious tone.

headings.usage: Use for step titles, page headers, and major data points.

body.usage: Use for all form labels, input text, and dashboard tabular data.

mono.usage: Use for ISRC, UPC, C-Line, P-Line, and transaction IDs.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders for Admin Dashboard (technical, high density). Flat solid surfaces with 1px border-border/40 for forms.
visual_enhancers.borders: Cardless layout preferred. 1px solid strokes with 2px inner glow for active inputs.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to none. Rely on borders and background contrast for depth.

label_submission_flow.pattern: Vertical Stepper / Multi-step Form with Progressive Disclosure
steps: 2. Artists & Credits (Primary, Feat, C/P Line, Year)
3. Tracks & Audio (Repeater if EP/Album, WAV upload, Lyrics, ISRC, Writers)
label_submission_flow.spacing: Generous (p-8 to p-12) for the form container to prevent cognitive overload.

admin_dashboard.components: Data tables for submitted releases, detail slide-overs (sheets) for review, inline status toggles.

components.forms: Use React Hook Form with Zod for strict validation (3000x3000 image validation, WAV 44.1/48kHz audio validation).
components.repeaters: Use useFieldArray for unlimited Primary Artists, Feat Artists, and Tracks. Each artist row must have an optional Spotify URL input.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI customized for Dark Mode. Use clear red text and red border outlines for validation errors.
components.conditional_logic: If 'Instrumental' == YA -> Hide Lyrics text area, auto-fill 'Instrumental'.
components.admin_actions: Sticky bottom action bar on the Review page to Reject, Request Revision (Need Revision), Approve, or Send Xendit Payment Link.

motion.transitions: Use Framer Motion for smooth accordion expansions (Track lists) and sliding between form steps.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on buttons (-translate-y-px), clear focus rings on form inputs (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA standards. Use gray-400 for hints, never darker.
accessibility.keyboard: Full keyboard navigability for the massive form. Enter to move to next input.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-release-button', data-testid='add-feat-artist').

media.uploads: Implement drag-and-drop zones for Artwork and Audio. Must show clear validation states (e.g., 'Image must be exactly 3000x3000px').

dashboard_header.description: Music recording studio. Use as a very subtle, low-opacity (10-15%) background graphic in the hero/welcome area of the Label dashboard.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI (JavaScript versions).
Build a robust 4-step wizard for the Label submission flow to handle the massive amount of metadata.
Implement dynamic form fields using repeaters for Artists and Tracks. For EP/Album, tracks must be an array of objects containing Audio, Lyrics, ISRC, and explicit flags.
Ensure the 'Instrumental' toggle automatically sets Lyrics to 'Instrumental' and disables the text area.
Date picker for Digital Release Date must disable dates less than 7 days from today.
Build a separate Admin view that renders the submitted data in a highly dense, read-only grid layout.
Implement the complex status state machine: Annual/VIP skips the 'Awaiting Payment' state.
Provide a 'Need Revision' action that pushes the release back to the Label's Drafts.
In the 'Live' admin step, provide inputs to attach the final UPC and missing ISRCs.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded with interaction animations).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
